technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions with bullish micro-structure conflict with weak intermediate trend structure and price below key moving averages; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 76 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (344.64), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent CPI miss create severely unfavourable macro conditions for tech equities despite distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme market fear (VIX crisis, 34 Fear/Greed score) combined with short-term overbought micro-structure (RSI 9 extreme, three white soldiers) and contrarian sentiment create a classic capitulation bounce setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all major moving averages (EMA 50, SMA 50/200), intermediate trend structure is bearish across multiple timeframes (EMA/SMA 20/50 crosses, Ichimoku below cloud), macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve), and fundamentals offer zero bullish catalysts with high earnings risk in 76 days.
